patch_description: This replaces batch-screened neighborhood search with a tempered trajectory search. It spends LP calls on individual proposals, alternating between bottleneck-weighted degree-preserving switches and occasional recombination of strong archived networks. A cyclic temperature schedule accepts some worsening moves to escape local minima, while an elite archive preserves the best solutions and supplies restart points. This gives the search a different exploration pattern and avoids spending many LP calls on a single surrogate-ranked batch.
